`vertical.jpg` is an original synthetic 1×2 black/white raster, encoded from a
handwritten 24-bit BMP with macOS `sips -s format jpeg -s formatOptions 100`.
SHA-256: `54bd5494567f5480a5665051638bdad44af5fe6620048619a9ac01a1dc77c724`.
The test injects a literal EXIF orientation=6 APP1 record and verifies the decoder
keeps the stored 1×2 orientation and expected dark/light samples. Other PNG/BMP
inputs are written independently with zlib/CRC or raw BMP rows in the tests;
the single-frame GIF is a literal one-pixel fixture. No external image is used.

P3-07 replacement PNGs are original synthetic patterns generated by
`python3 tests/fixtures/heightmaps/generate-decoder-fixtures.py`, using only Python
struct/zlib/binascii. They independently encode RGBA8/16 (including Adam7), packed
1-bit grayscale and 2-bit palette primaries. Literal pixel expectations live in
HeightmapDecoderTests, rather than being derived from the production decoder.
